Trigger.Name: KEY-NEXT-ITEM
Trigger.TriggerText:
declare
 temp_id VARCHAR2(10);
 ignore_payee VARCHAR2(2) := 'PA';
 find_all VARCHAR2(2) := '';
 check_eff_date boolean := True;
begin
 if :product.customer_id is not null
 then
 select_customer(:product.customer_id, find_all, ignore_payee,
 check_eff_date, temp_id);
 if temp_id is not null
 then
 :product.customer_id := temp_id;
 else
 return;
 end if;
 end if;
 execute_trigger('validate_field');
 check_package_failure;
 go_query('tiers');
end;

Trigger.Name: VALIDATE_FIELD
Trigger.TriggerText:
begin
 nullchk;
 select substr(name,1,30) into :s_customer_name
 from customers
 where customer_id = :product.customer_id
 and customer_type != 'PA'
 and chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id
 and sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date,sysdate+1);
 exception
 when NO_DATA_FOUND
 then
 show_error_dist('0302'); -- invalid customer
 check_package_failure;
 when OTHERS
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
end;

Trigger.Name: VALIDATE_FIELD
Trigger.TriggerText:
declare
 duplicate boolean;
begin
 nullchk;
 check_duplicate(:product_type,'product_type');
 select product_type, product_type_desc,
 life_span,decode(life_span_ind,'HR','Hours',
 'DY','Days',
 'YR','Years')
 into :tiers.product_type, :tiers.s_product_desc,
 :life_span, :s_lifespan_ind
 from vserv_product_types
 where product_type = :tiers.product_type
 and sysdate between eff_date
 and nvl(term_date,sysdate+365);
 exception
 when VALUE_ERROR
 then
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 when NO_DATA_FOUND
 then
 show_error_dist('0322'); -- Invalid product type

 when OTHERS
 then
 Handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
end;

Item.Name: TIER
Item.Hint: Enter a preferred tier for this product

Trigger.Name: PRE-TEXT-ITEM
Trigger.TriggerText:
declare
 temp_count number;
begin
 select count(*) into temp_count
 from product_pricing_matrix
 where chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id
 and product_type = :tiers.product_type
 and sysdate between eff_date
 and nvl(term_date,sysdate+365);
 if temp_count > 0
 then
 :GLOBAL.customer_pricing := 'TRUE';
 else
 :GLOBAL.customer_pricing := 'FALSE';
 end if;
 exception
 when others
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
end;

Item.Name: FROM_DAY
Item.Hint: Enter from days to expiration of product

Trigger.Name: VALIDATE_FIELD
Trigger.TriggerText:
begin
 nullchk;
 check_package_failure;
 if :from_day >= :product.life_span
 then
 :from_day := Null;
 show_error_dist('7500');
 /*7500 - From days must be less than the lifespan of
 the product */
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 exception
 when VALUE_ERROR
 then
 raise form_trigger_failure;
end;

Item.Name: TO_DAY
Item.Hint: Enter to days to expiration of product

Trigger.Name: VALIDATE_FIELD
Trigger.TriggerText:
begin
 nullchk;
 if (:to_day > :life_span)
 then
 :to_day := Null;
 show_error_dist('7501');
 /*7501 - To Days cannot be greater than the lifespan of
 the product */
 check_package_failure;
 elsif (:to_day < :from_day)
 then
 :to_day := Null;
 show_error_dist('7502');
 /*7502 - To Days cannot be less than from days */
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 exception
 when VALUE_ERROR
 then
 raise form_trigger_failure;
end;

Item.Name: EFF_DATE
Item.Hint: Enter the effective date for this pricing tier

Trigger.Name: PRE-TEXT-ITEM
Trigger.TriggerText:
declare
 v_local_time date;
 v_local_date date;
begin
 if :default_date is not null
 then
 :eff_date := :default_date;
 else
 IF is_timezone_enabled then
 Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id,sysdate,v_local_time);
 v_local_date := v_local_time;
 else
 v_local_date := sysdate;
 end if;
 :eff_date :=v_local_date;
 end if;
end;

Trigger.Name: VALIDATE_FIELD
Trigger.TriggerText:
declare
 v_local_time date;
 v_local_date date;
begin
 nullchk;
 IF is_timezone_enabled then
 Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id,sysdate,v_local_time);
 v_local_date := v_local_time;
 else
 v_local_date := sysdate;
 end if;
 if :eff_date < trunc(v_local_date)
 then
 show_error_dist('0501');
 /*0501 - Effective date must be >= current date */
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 if :default_date is null
 then
 :default_date := :eff_date;
 end if;
 exception
 when VALUE_ERROR
 then
 raise form_trigger_failure;
end;

ProgramUnit.Name: PRINT_RECORD
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
procedure print_record is
begin
 message('chapter_id = ' || :tiers.chapter_id);
 message('product_type = ' || :tiers.product_type);
 message('tier = ' || to_char(:tiers.tier));
 message('from_day = ' || to_char(:tiers.from_day));
 message('to_day = ' || to_char(:tiers.to_day));
 message('unit_price = ' || to_char(:tiers.unit_price));
 message('eff_date = ' || to_char(:tiers.eff_date));
 message('term_date = ' || to_char(:tiers.term_date));
end;

RecordGroup.Name: TIERS_TIER_LOV2
RecordGroup.RecordGroupQuery: select tier, substr(' ' || to_char(from_day,'99') || ' to ' || to_char(to_day,'9999') || ' days',1,25), to_char(unit_price,'999.99') from product_pricing_matrix where product_type = :tiers.product_type and chapter_id = :g_chapter_id and ((:product.customer_id is null and customer_id = 'STANDARD') or (:product.customer_id is not null and customer_id = :product.customer_id)) and sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date,sysdate+365)

RecordGroup.Name: TIERS_PRODUCT_TYP_LOV1
RecordGroup.RecordGroupQuery: select product_type, substr(product_type_desc,1,30), sort_sequence from vserv_product_types where sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date,sysdate+365) order by sort_sequence

RecordGroup.Name: PRODUCT_CUSTOMER_ID_LOV0
RecordGroup.RecordGroupQuery: select customer_id, substr(name,1,30), substr(phone_no,1,12) from customers where customer_type != 'PA' and sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date,sysdate+1) and ( customer_id = :product.customer_id or upper(name) like :product.customer_id || '%') and chapter_id = :confirm.g_chapter_id order by customer_id

Trigger.Name: KEY-CLRREC
Trigger.TriggerText:
begin

 then
 clear_record;
 else
 clear_record;
 down;
 end if;
end;

Trigger.Name: KEY-COMMIT
Trigger.TriggerText:
begin
 execute_trigger('validate_field');
 check_package_failure;
 if :system.form_status not in ('NEW','INSERT','CHANGED')
 then
 show_error_dist('0601');
 /* 0601 - No change to commit */
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 if :tiers.product_type is not null
 and :tiers.tier is not null
 and :tiers.from_day is not null
 and :tiers.to_day is not null
 and :tiers.eff_date is not null
 then
 commit_transaction;
 else
 show_error_dist('0204');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
end;
